owner_authority: Source-complete deep-methodology goal in this conversation
parent_outcome: OPEN; substantive source audit continues over checkpointed passes

passes.title: Acquire and qualify sources
passes.done_when: Every supplied file has an identity, digest, reading route, completeness caveat and source-list disposition. Not full-text reading.

passes.title: Map every section
passes.done_when: Every contents section has an exact locator, genre, prerequisites and source/commentary distinction; unread/missing units remain explicit. Confirm image-only TOCs and actual text spans.

passes.title: Read and extract conditional rules
passes.done_when: Each readable in-scope unit has been read and all operational conditions, modifiers, exceptions, contrary rules and worked examples dispositioned. No person histories.

passes.title: Reconcile authors and test calculations
passes.done_when: Agreements, disagreements and dependent reuses are linked without erasing variants; calculations checked with declared calendars, frames and uncertainty.

passes.title: Compile, freeze and evaluate
output: versioned implemented profiles and candidate-registry updates
passes.done_when: Implemented rules have boundary/negative tests and source links, then separately frozen person-level comparisons. New rules retained, not automatically validated.
